description:
Outcome: Coordinator reviews applications, allocates and manages FIFO, from brief.md First version must 2
Scope: Controls backed by T-006, application/preference context, accessible plain list of assignments and available plots. Excludes: spatial map/grid (post-v1 T-014), gardener-wide directory
Acceptance: List matches persisted assignments; queue order and limits clear; keyboard and phone usable; no unauthorized coordinator access
Behaviour: Loading/empty/error states, mutation confirmation, stale-conflict refresh
Verification: Role-protected E2E allocate/waitlist/promote journey and keyboard/mobile checks. Prerequisites: T-006. Assumptions: checkpoint-reviewed rules; no visual map in v1
title: Coordinator allocation workspace
